description: Use this when a merchant asks which app to use for something on their Shopify store, in any language: e.g. a sticky add to cart bar or cart drawer, bundles or quantity breaks, an email popup or spin wheel, store translation, accessibility, page speed or SEO, or a free shipping, free gift / rewards, announcement or countdown bar. Returns the best-matching EA app(s): the Shopify App Store name, one line on what it does and an install link. Works without signing in and doesn't read any store; for the apps already installed on the connected store, use list_apps.

need.description: What the merchant wants, in their words (e.g. "a sticky add to cart bar").

name: find_ea_app
title: Find the right EA app
